settings_vertical_viewing_angle_wider_an: 垂直视角。更大的角度可显示更多场景。
settings_visible_height_in_world_units_s: 以世界单位表示的可见高度。较小值会放大；宽度随视口纵横比变化。
settings_closest_visible_distance_keepin: 最近可见距离。适当增大可提高深度精度。
settings_farthest_visible_distance_must_: 最远可见距离。必须大于近裁剪距离。
settings_editor_camera_position_in_world: 编辑器相机的世界坐标（X、Y、Z）。
settings_return_to_the_starting_viewpoin: 返回初始视点。保留镜头和导航设置。
settings_synchronize_presentation_with_t: 将呈现与显示器刷新率同步。适用于当前编辑器会话。
settings_camera_settings_will_be_saved_w: 相机设置将随项目保存。
settings_camera_settings_for_this_sandbo: 当前沙盒会话的相机设置。

inspector_source_radius_help: 仅用于路径追踪。发光球的半径，单位为世界单位；设为0时产生硬阴影。
inspector_angular_radius_help: 仅用于路径追踪。光源圆盘的半角，单位为度；设为0时产生硬阴影。
material_thin_walled_help: Path tracing: a thin sheet transmits without bending and uses both interfaces. Roughness is ignored for this model. Closed solids use their actual interior distance for absorption.
material_bssrdf_help: Photon-beam diffusion transports light between surface points. Use a closed mesh with consistent outward normals. Coefficients are in inverse millimeters; 0.001 scene units per millimeter means one scene unit is a meter. Raster diffusion controls below are independent.
material_conductor_help: Path tracing uses exact complex-IOR Fresnel and GGX reflection. Presets sample PBRT metal spectra at 610/550/460 nm; they are RGB approximations. Raster and thumbnails use their normal-incidence reflectance in the existing metal BRDF.
material_medium_help: Path tracing: a closed dielectric may contain a homogeneous scattering medium. Coefficients use inverse scene units. IOR 1 and transmission 1 make an invisible fog boundary. Thin sheets have no scattering interior.
volume_height_help: Density decreases above the entity height. Below it, density stays constant.
volume_grid_help: The material stores a trilinear 3D density grid, with x changing fastest and voxel values in [0,1].
volume_empty_grid: No density grid assigned; this material has zero density.
volume_preview_help: Assign this material to a cloud or fog entity to preview its volume in the Scene or Game view.
volume_wind_help: Wind advances during Play and Simulate.
volume_material_help: Drop a volume material here, or click to open its properties in the Material Editor.
volume_unique_help: Create an independent copy for this entity. Other entities keep the shared material.
platform_placeholder_help: 仅供预览。这些选项暂不影响构建、打包或部署。

world_selector_hint: 选择一个随附的演示并在编辑器中打开。
world_selector_empty: 未找到随附的演示项目。
world_selector_no_matches: 没有符合搜索条件的世界。
world_selector_select_hint: 选择一个世界以查看详情。双击卡片即可打开。
world_demo_Car_Demo_description: 在赛道上驾驶车辆，体验跟随相机和使用 Canvas 制作的 HUD。
world_demo_Cloth_Playground_description: 模拟悬挂的旗帜、披在球体上的布料和可变形物体。模拟时可用手形工具抓取并移动粒子。
world_demo_Clustered_Lighting_descriptio: 探索 Sponza 中庭和周围的开阔地面，体验 13,500 盏动态点光源和 1,500 盏动态聚光灯。
world_demo_Instancing_description: 通过一个由 67 × 67 × 67 个立方体组成的网格测试实例化绘制与裁剪。所有立方体共享同一个网格资源。
world_demo_Optical_Materials_description: 对比折射、透射及金属材质，并查看吸收和次表面散射示例。
world_demo_Physics_Boxes_description: 观察 1,000 个动态方块下落、碰撞并最终停在静态几何体上。
world_demo_Physics_Spheres_description: 观察 1,000 个动态球体滚动、碰撞并最终停在静态几何体上。
world_demo_Sandbox_description: 在同一个演示中探索车辆、角色控制器、Canvas 界面和场景资源。
world_demo_Skeletal_Animation_descriptio: 400 个死侍实例共享一个模型，各自运行独立的动画器。
world_demo_Sphere_Materials_description: 在相同的光照条件下比较 5 × 5 个球体的材质。
world_demo_Video_Gallery_description: 在 3D 展厅中自由飞行，通过两块自发光屏幕体验视频播放和空间音频。
world_demo_Terrain_Coast_description: 在光栅渲染器中探索大型高度图地形、FFT 海洋和大气光照。
world_demo_Skin_Subsurface_description: 使用同一个头部扫描模型，对比左侧的标准光照和右侧的皮肤次表面散射。
world_demo_Dragon_Transmission_descripti: 在同一背光下比较四条玻璃龙，观察吸收和粗糙度如何改变透射光。
world_demo_Volumes_description: 对比天空云层、局部风暴云、盒形薄雾、全局雾霭以及由密度网格生成的球形雾体积。
world_demo_Particle_Museum_description: 探索使用Kenney粒子与烟雾素材制作的十座大型展台，欣赏火焰、喷泉、烟柱、闪电、魔法门、星尘、能量刃、爆炸与光雕。点击播放或模拟即可运行。
world_demo_Animation_Playground_descript: 使用环绕相机探索台阶和不平地面，体验待机、行走与奔跑的交叉淡化、足部 IK、注视与手臂伸展，以及导入角色。
